fields.summary_ko.0: Intel (NASDAQ:INTC) stock rose 4% on Monday, and New Street Research analyst Pierre Ferragu provided a target price of $125 (38% upside) and suggested the possibility of expanding server capacity by more than 50% in 2027 due to increased server CPU demand.
fields.summary_ko.1: Ferragu predicts that server CPU supply shortages due to agent AI demand will persist for years, and estimates that server CPU revenue will reach $50B by 2030 and EPS will increase from consensus estimate of $1.50 (2026) to $7.10.
fields.summary_ko.2: Intel announced the acquisition of Classiq, a quantum computing software developer.
